title: Simple Encrypted Calendar with Events and Tasks

requirements.text: Implement Internet Identity sign-in and require an authenticated session before any calendar data (events/tasks) can be created, viewed, edited, or deleted.

quotes: I want you to create a encrypted calendar application.

acceptanceCriteria: Unauthenticated users see a clear sign-in prompt and cannot access calendar content.
Authenticated users can access their own calendar content.

requirements.text: Add client-side encryption for all event/task content using Web Crypto so that the backend only stores ciphertext (no plaintext titles/descriptions/details). Use a user-provided passphrase to derive an encryption key (PBKDF2 + per-user salt) and encrypt/decrypt with an authenticated encryption scheme (e.g., AES-GCM).
acceptanceCriteria: Events and tasks are encrypted in the browser before being sent to the backend.
The backend stores only encrypted payloads and required non-sensitive metadata (e.g., IDs, timestamps), not plaintext content.
On reload, the app requires the passphrase to decrypt and display existing events/tasks for the signed-in user.

requirements.text: Create backend data models and CRUD endpoints in the single Motoko actor to store, list, update, and delete encrypted calendar items per authenticated user (separately supporting 'event' and 'task' types).

quotes: I can create events and tasks

acceptanceCriteria: A signed-in user can create an encrypted event and later list, update, and delete it.
A signed-in user can create an encrypted task and later list, update, and delete it.
Users cannot read or modify other users' items (access control enforced by caller identity).

requirements.text: Build a small, simple UI that supports: (1) viewing a minimal month/week list of events, (2) a task list view, and (3) lightweight create/edit forms for events and tasks. Keep navigation minimal (e.g., tabs or a compact sidebar) and avoid feature creep.
acceptanceCriteria: Users can add/edit/delete an event from the UI.
Users can add/edit/delete a task from the UI.
The UI remains compact with only the necessary screens to manage events and tasks.

requirements.text: Use React Query for all server interactions (list/create/update/delete) with proper loading and error states, and ensure the UI updates immediately after mutations (invalidate/refetch or optimistic updates).

quotes: I can create events and tasks

acceptanceCriteria: During fetch/mutations, the UI shows a loading state and handles errors with a visible message.
After creating/updating/deleting an item, the list reflects the change without requiring a manual refresh.

requirements.text: Define a coherent visual theme for a compact encrypted productivity app (distinct colors, typography, spacing, and component styling) and apply it consistently across all screens. Do not use a blue/purple primary palette.
acceptanceCriteria: All screens share a consistent visual system (colors/typography/layout).
Primary styling does not use a blue/purple dominant palette.

constraints: Backend must remain a single Motoko actor in backend/main.mo.
Do not edit frontend files under frontend/src/components/ui or any paths listed as immutable in SYSTEM_CONTEXT.
All encryption/decryption must occur on the client; the backend must not require plaintext to function.
nonGoals: Shared calendars, multi-user collaboration, or invitations.
Recurring events, reminders, notifications, or email integrations.
Full-text search over encrypted content on the backend.
